title: P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet: Werke Band II Source-Checked Editions and English Translations
version: 2026-06-04 Dirichlet Werke Band II Papers I-XXXVI
description: Dedicated P. G. Lejeune Dirichlet author record for source-checked editions and English translations. Current reader/source surface covers Werke Band II Papers I-XXXVI, including original-language cumulative readers, English translation readers, component TeX/PDF files, source scans, and checking artifacts. The latest addition extends the cumulative readers through Paper XXXVI, the correspondence between Lejeune Dirichlet and Gauss, with source witnesses for Werke Band II source PDF pages 386-400.
notes: Current public surface promotes Werke Band II Papers I-XXXVI as the dedicated Dirichlet author lane. The older classical shelf remains an umbrella/backstop.
